selection.rule: Two paired-paragraph speakers per grade/gender stratum, sorted pools and fixed RNG seed; shuffle all 24 recordings once. No selection by duration, transcript quality, miscues, audio or ASR outcome.

execution.warmup: No separate inference warmup; first reading includes first-inference effects.

pre_audio_transport_failures.reason: Windows socket permissions blocked the WebSocket connection (WinError 10013) before the streaming session started.
pre_audio_transport_failures.retry: Identical frozen selection, order, matcher, model, settings and manifests; local network access enabled. No sample replacement or recognition-outcome-based retry.

split_anchor_evidence.kind: Complete exact split-anchor support in emitted decision buffers; diagnostic evidence, not an instrumented permission-route trace.

provider_annotation_review.note: Provider annotations flag review candidates. Substitutions may be acceptable pronunciation attempts; these counts are not an effect-accuracy or latency score.

cases.human_should_emit: Yes in initial review; endpoint quality subsequently qualified
cases.clarity: Phrase heard; final wing is soft and possibly cut off, per user follow-up.
cases.time_meaning: User confirms the phrase clearly at the end of the last-20-second excerpt. No exact word-end time was supplied.
cases.diagnosis: Final unpadded ASR omits wing and tracking stops at 79/80. The user hears the phrase but qualifies wing as soft/possibly cut off. Two fresh diagnostic streams reproduce the original miss and recover wing plus the effect with two seconds of added digital silence. Speech samples, matcher and recognizer settings are unchanged. This supports trailing-context/end-of-stream sensitivity; the specific implementation/model cause is not isolated. The original held-out results remain unchanged.

listening_history.note: User qualifies the earlier clear-endpoint judgment. The phrase remains reported audible; trigger acceptance was not explicitly re-decided.

cases.endpoint_quality_user_note: Final wing sounds soft and kind of cut off.

post_evaluation_human_review.scope: Only listed cases have user listening confirmation. Phrase-location marks are not verified word endpoints.

unrelated_speech_replay.kind: Saved ASR callbacks from four existing fresh unrelated-speech streams, replayed against six frozen passage manifests; not additional fresh audio trials.

limits: Held-out speaker IDs on the same six familiar Indian MPS paragraph texts; not held-out books or Singapore-accent validation.
Single fresh stream per selected recording. Old/new guards share identical ASR callbacks; only current guard ran through the live app.
Human listening applies only to explicitly attached post-evaluation reviews; no exact word-end timestamps are verified.
Effects emitted/withheld/unreached/skipped are operational outcomes, not pronunciation or checkpoint precision/recall.
Raw recordings, provider transcripts and review clips remain local under ignored output/.
